content.heading: Penalty for default
content.text: The Court may compel the attendance of any person to whom a summons has been issued under section 30 and for that purpose may (a) issue a warrant for his arrest; (b) attach and sell his property; (c) impose a fine upon him not exceeding five thousand rupees; (d) order him to furnish security for his appearance and in default commit him to the civil prison.
content.historicalNotes: Fine ceiling raised from five hundred to five thousand rupees by the 1999 amendment (in force 1 July 2002). Read with Order XVI. Not a substitute for Order IX (defendant default) or Section 51 execution. Verify exact statutory text against India Code before relying in court.
exceptions: No Section 30 summons → Section 32 not attracted
